{{Quote|With all due respect, the ambassadors for the Supreme Chancellor wish to board immediately.|Maoi Madakor|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Maoi Madakor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shields up!|Maoi Madakor's last words|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Madakor was the captain of the [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']], and flew it during the [[Battle of Galidraan]]. The purpose of this mission was to transport [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was during this mission she met and befriended [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]], a pilot of the ''[[Acceptance]]''. Together, they flew together again at the [[Battle of Uhanayih]], where Williams' ship was destroyed, and he was reduced to flying [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] for [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name=":0">{{DB|character|ltwilliams|Williams, Lt. Antidar}}</ref>

The next year,<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> recalling their friendship and previous mission to [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]], she specifically chose Williams to be her copilot<ref name=":0" /> in a mission taking [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] so they could negotiate with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] due to their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Upon arriving at the system, she then made contact with the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] head of the Trade Federation, [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], requesting that the Jedi, identified as ambassadors to Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum, be allowed to board the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] immediately, with Gunray heeding the request. Although they succeeded in delivering them, they were ultimately forced to wait until the Jedi returned. However, they then discovered a turbolaser turret descend from the ceiling, poised to fire at the ''Radiant VII''. Unable to escape, she was killed when the Trade Federation's turbolaser fire destroyed her ship. Her last words were to raise the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], but it was too late.<ref name="Episode 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maoi Madakor was portrayed by [[Bronagh Gallagher]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Episode 1" /> In the opening cutscenes of the Episode I portion of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', she and Williams were replaced by [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] figures.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref><ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
